programme.title: 陰陽刀
programme.desc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?

programme.title: 弟子也瘋狂
programme.desc: 方世玉、洪熙官與胡惠乾三位俗家弟子初入少林,拜於南院戒嗔大師門下習武。然而,三人常與出家弟子悟清較勁切磋,寺中從此喧嚷不絕,連方丈見此情景亦不免啼笑皆非。

programme.title: 六刺客
programme.desc: 鎮國公李明恃強作惡,魚肉百姓。他的兄長雖是當今聖上,卻對李明的惡行束手無策。正氣凜然的劍客穆俊傑假扮成李明的護衛密謀刺殺行動。他先捉拿六名欲殺李明的刺客,再與他們結盟,密謀殺死李明以終止其暴行。

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?

programme.title: 黑店
programme.desc: 故事講述,江湖上傳出消息,巡撫海剛峰辭官歸里,所攜箱篋中珠寶價值連城,於是引起了一些歹人的覬覦。高家店店主高山峰、其姘婦鄧三娘,以及數幫黑道人物,均於高家店埋伏,準備等待海剛峰經過之時伺機下手…

programme.title: 武則天
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

programme.title: 毒龍潭
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙,盜去師父的玉龍劍,並生下一子一女;後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭,唐抱子虞江逃走,女青兒則歸師公門下;二十年後,劍再次被盜,青女扮男裝,私下尋劍,卻遇樊舊友天涯客

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜
programme.desc: 孫玉郎與劉慧娘,裴政與徐雅本是兩對情投意合的戀人,陰差陽錯間,孫玉郎男扮女裝代姊拜堂,劉慧娘則代兄娶妻。他們的婚約誤配,讓成誤會,終鬧上公堂,喬太守將錯就錯,乾脆來了一個亂點,結果正好有情人終成眷屬,皆大歡喜。

programme.title: 千門八將
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述,正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次,他在與“賭魔”的賭局中,被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後,賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇,正將被賭魔以千術擊敗,含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇,邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博

programme.title: 風花雪月
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路

programme.title: 少林傳人
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位,率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮;皇帝見大勢已去,命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養,法號道行,習得少林絕技;二太子則易名五子泰,由丞相撫養。多年後,五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」,與道行相遇,卻不知對方正是親兄弟……

programme.title: 梅山收七怪
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃,但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間,導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪,否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 惡爺
programme.desc: 故事講述,惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋,蘇老闆欺善怕惡,把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡,遂暗中模仿其動作練武;一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾,阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃…

programme.title: 惡爺
programme.desc: 故事講述,惡少洪毛九不時到蘇記飯店滋事搗蛋,蘇老闆欺善怕惡,把滿腔氣憤發洩在夥記阿七身上。後阿七發覺小廚師張彪武功不凡,遂暗中模仿其動作練武;一日洪毛九又來飯店滋擾,阿七施展出所練功夫打得洪毛九狼狽而逃…

programme.title: 太極拳
programme.desc: 顧定是太極高手,卻隱藏身份為一名建築工人。當他的女朋友被惡霸強暴後,顧定唯有迫不得已出手讓惡霸受到應有的懲罰,彰顯公義。

programme.title: 新不了情
programme.desc: 歌女青青與建築師湯鵬南原是一對感情深厚的情侶,可惜好景不常,湯家突遭巨變,青青不惜出賣自己肉體以相助鵬南,想不到竟被鵬南誤會而導致倆人分手。後來鵬南得知事情始末,欲挽回感情,可惜青青已患上絕症。

programme.title: 大俠沈勝衣
programme.desc: 武林中人對白家珍藏的「唐門火冊」虎視眈眈,後更揚言要擄劫其女。大俠沈勝衣於是建議以其情人煙飛代白家小姐,並尋出個中玄機

programme.title: 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室

programme.title: 流氓千王
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王,李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後,遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥,出千騙財,開設豪華賭場,欲將陳誘得入局…

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中,夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南,兩人漸生情愫,卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時,青青卻得知一個噩耗,最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。

programme.title: 大刀王五
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同,這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法,但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權,因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場,卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。

programme.title: 藍與黑續集
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集,唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯,在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞,但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍,叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。

programme.title: 飛刀手
programme.desc: 綽號飛刀追魂的焦雷與乾坤劍名手于遠結怨,焦要追殺于全家。幸得飛刀手楊青救了于的女兒于英;但楊青生性風流,向于英開出對付焦雷的條件是共渡一夜。于英憎惡他,又不得不和他一起助父親與焦雷決鬥。相處日久,于英才明白楊非登徒浪子,實對她深愛非常。

programme.title: 憤怒青年
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。

programme.title: 卒仔抽車
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子,遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成,達成了一個賭局,要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力,終戰勝億萬富豪!

programme.title: 北地胭脂
programme.desc: 本片由三個發生在妓院「百花樓」的單元故事組成。〈花街柳巷〉講述妓女大琴不甘淪落為娼,竟冒險向巡官告狀,要求救她脫離火坑;〈滿宮春色〉講述同治皇帝大婚之前,往妓院尋歡,終於染上梅毒不治;〈游龍豔史〉講述正德皇帝與名妓佛動心同入鴛帳

programme.title: 太陰指
programme.desc: 故事描述,路天保與兩個結拜兄弟,巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人

programme.title: 追魂鏢
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活,非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒,玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛,但玉蟬偶遇胡,誤信劉是殺母仇人…

programme.title: 追魂鏢
programme.desc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活,非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒,玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛,但玉蟬偶遇胡,誤信劉是殺母仇人…

programme.title: 阿牛發達記
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴。這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…

programme.title: 五大漢
programme.desc: 一班不打不相識之眾,聚集在一起以保護愛國將軍免被加害。他們充當將軍的護送人員,前往危險的遠方英國領事館,途中遭到敵人和日軍的陰險干擾。

programme.title: 噴火美人魚
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假,忽然聽到新聞報導:一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人,並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時,一個美的女郎破浪而來,身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚,女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突 電影未到最後一分鐘,不知結局。

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇,二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者!

programme.title: 多咀街
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。

programme.title: 黑蜥蜴
programme.desc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述,丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟,而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好,後來丁妻誕下一子,而蕭妻誕下一女,但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願,便來一個男女對換,惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧,手抱兒子往見丁,不料為蕭暗中看見,頓生綠帽疑雲,狠然佈下瘋子殺

programme.title: 鬼屋麗人
programme.desc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸。

programme.title: 阿牛出獄記
programme.desc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙

programme.title: 天龍八部
programme.desc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功,卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中,段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下,段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤,得到了絕世功力,最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 鬼太監
programme.desc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦,朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕,桂竟利用父女之情,假借燕燕之手殺朱锦

programme.title: 魚美人
programme.desc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。

programme.title: 雙星伴月
programme.desc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓,生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星,從此飛黃騰達,但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西

programme.title: 小鎮大俠
programme.desc: 影片講述了川劇名門得意弟子王大器學成出山,卻因恐台症不能亮相表演,只得在火鍋店靠變臉賺錢。原是必成大器現是碌碌無為,卻因一次行俠仗義走紅網路,一時成了人人口中的大英雄,從此走上了行俠仗義之路的故事。

programme.title: 風雲小棋王
programme.desc: 大明正德年間,西北的飛砂鎮上,神童朱鼎材棋藝高超,無人可比!在京城,大宦官劉瑾妄想篡位奪權,保皇的安華郡王發動兵諫被殺,而朱鼎材正是安化郡王的嫡孫,全家慘遭殺害時他倖免於難。劉瑾派遣東廠的精銳來殺朱鼎材!朱鼎材在世外高人`冬瓜老的點撥下,

programme.title: 青春逗
programme.desc: 東山大學“三劍客林漢傑、程銘、郝大雨,三位年輕人在離開大學進入社會的過程中,發生了一系列整蠱搞怪令人啼笑皆非的故事。家庭的突然破產令整蠱富二代林漢傑跌入穀底,畢業之後,所有人都找到了工作,只有林漢傑整日無所事事沒有方向。苦於無奈,林漢傑找

programme.title: 大刺客之娥眉刺
programme.desc: 康熙一統中國後,本以為可千秋萬代,永遠垂手而治;哪知禍起n蕭牆,亂源來自于宮中,他的十幾個兒子們,為了爭取接班人,開始明爭暗鬥,手段無所不用其極!其中,以四阿哥`胤禎的胸懷大志,有心統一天下,當時的權臣`隆科多,也就是他的舅父,為之出謀

programme.title: 神秘的大佛
programme.desc: 解放前,傳說樂山大佛下藏有巨額財富,不少探尋者來到此處,卻被可怕的怪面人害死,東南亞華僑司徒俊接到一個叫安康的人的來信,約他到樂山淩雲寺。當他到達樂山後,受到當地惡霸沙駝爺以及警方的觀注。沙駝爺的女教師夢婕也時常出現在他的身邊,經過小和尚的

programme.title: 錦衣衛之王者歸來
programme.desc: 明成祖朱棣駕崩後,明仁宗朱高熾即位,漢王朱高煦圖謀造反。錦衣衛十兄弟忠心護國,怎奈漢王詭計多端,結果錦衣衛指揮使被殺,秦風等人亡命天涯。n英雄蒙冤,何日歸來?秦風在鄉野和民女素涵相愛,然而,素涵的孿生姐姐素冰,卻是漢王帳下第一冷血殺手!這並

programme.title: 醉劍俠
programme.desc: 嘯西風雙親被害身亡,從此一蹶不振,整日借酒消愁。妻子月蓉帶著女兒九兒嫁給了鐵匠鋪掌櫃吳用。但不料月蓉和九兒被綁架,嘯西風重振精神與昔日的仇敵再度較量,最終救出妻女重新成為一名捕快。

programme.title: 戰將周希漢
programme.desc: 該片以1940年初侵華日軍重兵偷襲八路軍前線總指揮部的危急時刻,時任八路軍三八六旅參謀長周希漢抗命救駕的史實及一段情緣為依據,真誠的展現了大智大勇、敢作敢為、鐵骨柔腸的一代戰將周希漢——中國的巴頓。

programme.title: 八仙傳之鐵拐李濟世

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話

programme.title: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
programme.desc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #1 英普
programme.desc: 踏上前往斯奈爾斯群島原始荒野的冒險之旅,這裡是一片遠離波濤洶湧大海的動物保護區在這裡,與斯島黃眉企鵝群一起跳舞,與巨鹱和灰鹱一同翱翔,與巨型海獅一起咆哮

programme.title: 深藍巨獸 #2 英普
programme.desc: 啟程前往新西蘭的奧塔哥半島,這裡是瀕臨滅絕的海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的繁殖地在這裡,能夠看到海獅,信天翁,紅嘴鷗,白頭燕鷗和仙鋸鹱求偶與繁衍生息的場景

programme.title: 「礁」來船禍 #3
programme.desc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #3
programme.desc: 墨西哥尤卡坦半島是海龜和馬尾藻的家園,同時也是旅遊聖地;三者如何和諧共存?這個寶地可以持續發展嗎?揭開這個墨西哥海灘背後的秘密,包括每年舉行的一個古老分娩儀式

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #1
programme.desc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標

programme.title: 阿拉伯海 #2
programme.desc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害

programme.title: 野外紀事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊

programme.title: 野外紀事 #4 英普
programme.desc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化

programme.title: 野狗:與族群一起奔跑 #3
programme.desc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #2
programme.desc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」,見證寄居蟹有序排隊,以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣--貝殼進行交易然後走訪塞內加爾,探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐,並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安

programme.desc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船

programme.desc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 英普
programme.desc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚

programme.title: 南荒之地 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險

programme.desc: 讓我們一起瞭解這三個族群吧:在鬱鬱蔥蔥的中心地帶活動的大型曼茲族群,荒地的卡庫裡族群,以及生活在公園邊緣的小型鸛群聆聽朱爾茲講述它們在這個成敗攸關的賽季中的勝利和失敗事蹟

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 動物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人

programme.desc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船

programme.title: 海灘生命線 #4
programme.desc: 本集將為大家揭開夏威夷迷人海灘背後的科學秘密為甚麼細沙會呈現不同色彩,包括白色,黃色,黑色,綠色和紅色?活火山如何改變海岸線?是否有其他力量在塑造這些令人驚嘆的海灘?一起來深入暸解!

programme.title: 愛爾蘭:野性島嶼 #1 英普
programme.desc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 英普
programme.desc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚

programme.title: 南荒之地 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險

programme.title: 野外紀事 #4 英普

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #3 英普
programme.desc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用

programme.title: 維修的奧秘 2 #3

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed

Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:另類的計算 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯

programme.title: 屬靈教室:葉劍華牧師-喜樂的人生
programme.desc: 在腓立比書出現了12次「喜樂」,是新約中出現最多「喜樂」的書卷。基督教樂恩堂堂主任葉劍華牧師,就會從腓立比書教導觀眾如何在困難中、服事中活出喜樂,並且將喜樂帶給身邊的人。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列

programme.title: 靈修早晨

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#115粵
programme.desc: 原來慶這段日子頻頻失蹤，目的是尋找失散的弟弟、家族隱藏的族譜及寶藏。眾人為避免秘密洩漏，竟狠心將亨排除在外。對於突然被疏離，亨憤憤不平。另一方面，眾人努力搜查後，發現寶藏竟埋藏於亨所新購入的別墅當中。

programme.title: 夢華錄#21粵普
programme.desc: 歐陽旭當清客，被路經西京的柯政訓斥，柯政不接受其辯解，還將他過往所贈之物全部歸還。千帆查閱盼兒父親案的卷宗，令他不知如何面對盼兒，連盼兒需要錢開酒樓也讓陳廉跑腿，恰巧他又被安排接洽北使，更是分身不暇。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 三文魚含豐富的奧米加3，肥媽用44元便煮出三文魚三吃，而且只需兩個步驟便煮出名貴日菜鹽燒三文魚頭，魚頭香脆可口，連骨頭亦可食用。除了用胡椒去除三文魚的腥味外，肥媽還另有秘訣。「大廚平煮」有鴛鴦蝦多士。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿自參加無綫電視第18期藝員訓練班入行，轉瞬已二十五載。他近年多棲發展，既是演員、監製，又身兼飲食集團創意總監，更是兩子之父，認為哪個身分最具挑戰？諾懿亮相節目，分享育兒心得，以及多年的演藝得着。「跟大廚去搵食」，許美德師傅接力登場，引領大王、菲比品味上海名菜，「蔥燒海參」、「干燒明蝦球」、「樟茶大鴨」等大菜悉數上桌，展現上海菜的精緻技藝。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「豆醬蒜苗薑爆雞」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 接着的動作題是要令木板上的劃痕變淡，「孖妹」與兩隊猛男對壘，某隊更因大力擦木板而打翻物品，認真激烈。來到從雪櫃找答案，究竟甚麼物品能去除衣物上的油性筆跡？兩隊均鎖定「熟米飯」作目標，可會是正確答案？踏入搶答題回合，經過三條問題，某藝人隊暫時領先，令人大跌眼鏡。「朱古力」是裝修術語，但裝修老闆、油漆工人都不知為何物！有隊伍於尾聲連續答對兩題追至與對手同分，要以決勝題分高低，能否延續後上氣勢一舉晉級？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#22粵PG
programme.desc: 金仔為救露絲想盡方法，終於病倒。蔣嬌乘機軟禁金仔，霸佔財務公司，讓行健、Joey加入公司，俊軒當眾支持。耀宗、瑪莉闖入戴家見到金仔，金仔向瑪莉求救。瑪莉、宇森搬進戴家，宇森與金仔暗中商量反擊大計。行健讓蔣嬌參加財務形象大使選舉，宇森、瑪莉出現，指金仔已讓宇森加入公司，並參加選舉。選舉宴會中，宇森安排懷疑被騙的客戶莊太向行健質問，但行健約了莊生前來，莊太只好啞忍。蔣嬌對行健不滿，二人關係出現暗湧。

programme.desc: 夫妻感情要不時撻着「保鮮」？「麥包」麥長青豪言未曾「死火」，至今仍與太太牽手共枕。麥玲玲指男人天生懶惰，不愛製造浪漫，「豹哥」單立文卻稱最難是心中有儀式感，更自揭有虛擬情人？羅泳嫻亦會與丈夫玩「角色扮演」？向伴侶表謝意，豹哥笑言被豹嫂馴服，讓他「壞變好」。麥包眼濕濕致電妻子，一句「多謝」盡在不言中！賴慰玲感恩老公從不與她吵架，被男嘉賓質疑過於抑壓情緒不健康？羅泳嫻封丈夫為「神隊友」，大曬其窩心事。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
無名天使3D#17粵PG
programme.desc: 天華告訴麗花會以香港為基地，新僱主是學文，麗花錯愕。堅強助麗花打發天華，二人一見面堅強即怒斥身為兄長的天華當年不辭而別，累他買樓賠償訂金。麗花向天華借錢助堅強開車行，天華爽快答應，麗花看出天華關心堅強，而堅強所著重的非只是金錢，還有兄弟情。車行張老闆反悔拒賣車行，麗花不惜動用私蓄替堅強補差價，更買按摩椅贈張老闆，終打動他答應賣車行給堅強。樂琦負責盤問證人Matt，逼使他指證學文，他拒絕後自殺身亡。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵PG
programme.desc: 第二條動作題關於怎樣加強吸盤吸附油漆牆的效果，當對手們仍在思考方法，有人迅速示意完成……檸檬酸配合甚麼物品，可有效去除熱水壺水垢？從雪櫃找答案，某隊信心十足，無懼森美質疑，大膽還擊！終極回合，艾妮快而準答中清潔劑與水費兩題；拍檔靖韻笑言撳燈亦有學問？男子組還以顏色，題目聽到一半就知答案。某人憑直覺答題未算誇張；泳兒竟稱雪櫃冷凍格設於攝氏15度？搶答比拼突變相親環節，更有隊伍好運到獨攬三條夾萬鎖匙！

programme.title: 街坊財爺#24粵PG
programme.desc: 行健向眾人表示蔣嬌決定放假，將公司交予自己打理，加上俊軒5%股權，他已擁有公司55%股權，決定賣盤。金仔與二人反面，怒傷俊軒。警方與金仔暗中開會，原來雙方知道行健是國際大老千，所以警民合作；金仔與俊軒反面是計，宇森辭職入財務公司也是計。金仔向行健回購公司，行健開價十億。行健帶金仔到骨灰場拜祭，原來金仔父子當年追債逼死行健父母，行健回來報仇。宇森跟蹤Joey，懷疑蔣嬌藏參船上，卻被Joey發現襲擊。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#117粵
programme.desc: 高家正如火如荼在亨的別墅搜索之際，亨卻突然回來，幸只是虛驚一場。明向麗說研究失敗而用盡麗的五十萬，感沒面目而避開她，要求麗再借一千萬給他。亨得悉二人關係後，再借出一千萬，並請明與高家見面，明無奈答應。

programme.title: 夢華錄#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒去找望月樓老闆商量寬限的事，但對方不肯通融。盼兒怕保不住茶坊，又怕連累長風，不敢跟他借錢，只能去找池蟠…如琢帶引章去見林三司，為他獻藝，林三司垂涎她的美色，此時引章遇到好好，好好提醒她要加以防犯。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 洛杉磯一輛餐車提供可「救地球」的食物是甚麼？進食台北某食店的招牌菜前，為何要勞煩一位男店員？王貽興及黎諾懿還要猜猜韓國某款熱賣甜品名稱，並在得到Do姐的提示後都答中了，貽興還替它改了一個更優雅的名字！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 節目拜訪東京「咖喱科學家」，一嚐奇怪的咖喱飯配搭；參觀首爾的戲劇主題咖啡店，看看特別餐牌；見識秘魯人百年前釀粟米酒的駭人「精華」。吳若希被拍檔C君、鄭俊弘看扁必敗於衛志豪及陸浩明手上，她能否挽回面子？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.desc: When an art conservator mysteriously drowns in the Canale dei Marani in Venice, his widow Anna investigates the suspicious circumstances of his death. In the course of doing so, she is led into a jungle of lies, fraud, and art theft.

programme.title: Masha
programme.desc: Masha has grown up between the boxing ring and the streets of her provincial Russian town. Her closest friends, young gangsters who are loathed by the entire town, love and protect her. And suddenly the cruel truth about them is revealed to her.

programme.title: Elaha
programme.desc: Elaha, a young Kurdish-German woman, battles patriarchy and family expectations while seeking her own path. Elaha struggles with traditions, marriage and virginity, and she must choose between emancipation or delusion.

programme.title: Cortina Express
programme.desc: During the Christmas holidays in Cortina, a colorful cast of characters cross paths among the snow-capped Ampezzo mountains. Between love, redemption, and second-chances, their lives collide in a series of hilarious and heartfelt quests for a happy ending

programme.title: The Key Witness
programme.desc: BKA bodyguard Jan Schäfer must protect Fiona Weibel, a key witness for the International Tribunal of the Law of the Sea. With Weiber having insider knowledge of a Swiss shipping company's illicit activities, a game of cat and mouse over her life begins.

programme.title: Heart Of A Lion
programme.desc: Teppo, the leader of a gang of neo-nazis, falls in love with Sari. To his shock, Sari’s son is black, and Teppo finds his prejudices and loyalties pitted against his desire for love and family.

programme.title: A Wedding
programme.desc: Zahira, eighteen years old, a Belgian-Pakistani girl wants to keep the baby growing inside her. Amir, her brother and confidant, promises to help her. But the parents have other ideas for the young girl.

programme.title: East Frisian: Night
programme.desc: Inspector Ann Kathrin Klaasen has to hunt a serial killer in East Frisia who targets women with “power animal” tattoos on their bodies. At the same time, she has to save her husband from disaster and face interference from the Federal Criminal Police.

programme.title: Bluebird
programme.desc: In small town Maine, a school bus driver becomes distracted during her end-of-day inspection and fails to notice a sleeping boy in the back of the bus. What happens next shatters the tranquillity of her small logging town.

programme.title: Falling Into Place
programme.desc: Kira and Ian meet all too briefly over a winter weekend on the Isle of Skye and form a sudden and deep bond. Back in London, they try to move on with their separate lives - but both have to stop running from themselves before they are ready to meet again.

programme.title: Death Comes To Venice
programme.desc: When an art conservator mysteriously drowns in the Canale dei Marani in Venice, his widow Anna investigates the suspicious circumstances of his death. In the course of doing so, she is led into a jungle of lies, fraud, and art theft.

programme.title: Out Of The Blue
programme.desc: A successful and dashing young man whose life of one-night stands seems to be going great until a teenybopper, claiming to be his daughter, knocks on his door.

programme.title: Just Like A Woman
programme.desc: Two women travel from Chicago to Santa Fe to escape their suffocating lives. Marilyn dreams of winning a contest held by a famous belly dancing company, while her friend, Mona, has a darker secret.

programme.title: Lightning-Struck
programme.desc: At her wedding in the Auvergne mountains, Lucie survives a lightning strike that kills her husband but leaves her with the ability to remember every moment of her life. At a reunion two years later, the survivors are targeted by a mysterious killer.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies

programme.desc: Duggee has a job to do outside of the Clubhouse. But who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger of course, he has his Babysitting Badge. But then the Squirrels end up babysitting King Tiger!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The A Cappella Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea team up to find treasure, but she tricks him to get it for herself.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Operation Jewel
programme.desc: Supertato is determined to rescue Tomato's precious jewel after Evil Pea steals it.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Honk Honk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S05 - Feather
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say `feather', and goes on a whirlwind word adventure. They see lots of different types of feathers: a grey feather, a spotty feather, a fluffy feather and a unicorn feather.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Sleepless in OKIDO
programme.desc: It's the Great OKIDO Sleepover, but there is a loud noise keeping Messy awake! With the help of Zoom, Messy must track down the noise to save the sleepover.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cliffhanger
programme.desc: Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo's tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Great Wall of China, China
programme.desc: Glitch and his grimbots have a long race on a very long wall - the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Fairies
programme.desc: Bluey's house has fairies! Tails are being braided, stickers are everywhere, and Mum's got a peg beard. Now the family must band together to hunt for these invisible mischief-makers.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Swim School
programme.desc: Mum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass Swim School but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret (aka Bluey) is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures S01 - Andy and The Manatee
programme.desc: When a crab inadvertently chops up some sea grass that Mr Hammond had collected for a manatee back at Safari World, it's up to Andy to save the day. Heading to the Caribbean, he goes in search of some more to replace it. But will Andy succeed?

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Mud
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Day Off Badge
programme.desc: It's Duggee's Day Off but it's not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off... earning their Day Off badges in the process!

programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiancé. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic "The Water Margin", and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity…

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora's Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.
